label: Maximum-first from prior causes: finite controls
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls on two beings and one respect read as esse: (1) the premises 'what is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to a thing causes its being' and 'no maximum in being has a distinct cause of its being' hold together with a maximum in being, a real priority edge into a non-maximal being, and the conclusion 'whatever is maximal in being is the first being'; (2) the first premise holds and the conclusion fails (everything is maximal and one being is simply prior to another), so the second premise does work; (3) the second premise holds (nothing causes anything) and the conclusion fails, so the first premise does work. Statements about these finite interpretations only; no premise is claimed true or false of reality.
